functions.description: staged loader for menu backgrounds and canvases
functions.lever: hoisted the per-iteration element pointer declaration (background/canvas) above each indexed loop, which swapped r8/sb so the loop counter takes sb
functions.notes: Modelled on ov013 func_ov013_02184d80. Stack slots matched by declaring name, file, files[2], size, sizes[2] in that order. Window pointer loaded once into a local for its two stores, then re-read for the LinkArrayPrevPointers call. The 4 bytes at data_ov017_021d643c are copied as two named 2-byte struct values (nibbles, priorities). 7 gate runs, no raw offset reads.
